Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by calling annotation.getClass() which returns a proxy class instead of the actual annotation type. This is demonstrated in the printAnnotationClass method.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling Example.showBug(), which in turn calls printAnnotationClass with the Deprecated annotation. Inside printAnnotationClass, annotation.getClass() is called, which returns a proxy class instead of the actual annotation type, triggering the bug.
